beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

timing.text: Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: John came to Jesus with a complaint. They'd seen someone driving out demons using Jesus's name — and the man wasn't one of their group. So they told him to stop.

timing.text: John came to Jesus with a complaint.
They'd seen someone driving out demons using Jesus's name — and the man wasn't one of their group.
So they told him to stop.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: John thought he was protecting the cause. The man wasn't with them, so he shouldn't be using the name.

timing.text: John thought he was protecting the cause.
The man wasn't with them, so he shouldn't be using the name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus didn't take John's side. He went after the instinct underneath the complaint.

timing.text: He went after the instinct underneath the complaint.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me. For he that is not against us is on our part.

timing.text: Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
For he that is not against us is on our part.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Don't stop him, He said. Nobody works a miracle in My name and then turns around and speaks against Me. Whoever isn't against us is on our side.

timing.text: Nobody works a miracle in My name and then turns around and speaks against Me.
Whoever isn't against us is on our side.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

timing.text: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Whoever gives a cup of water in His name won't lose his reward.

timing.text: Whoever gives a cup of water in His name won't lose his reward.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The work isn't about belonging to a team — it's about Him.

timing.text: The work isn't about belonging to a team — it's about Him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: John learned a lesson that day: the kingdom is bigger than the inner circle.

timing.text: John learned a lesson that day: the kingdom is bigger than the inner circle.

card.text: Don't draw the circle too small. Whoever works in His name is on your side.
